paragraphs: We find Rabbi Abba bar Rav Ada: Shabbat 130a. Rabbi Chanina son of Rav Ada: Shir HaShirim Rabbah, on “For better”; and in Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:4, Rabbi Chananyah son of Rav Ada. Mar bar Rav Ada: Shabbat 140b. Rava and Ravin bar Rav Ada: Beitzah 33b. Rabbah bar Rav Ada: Sukkah 3a.
